question: Who was the recipient of the National Devdasi Award in 2016?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prerana Deshpande**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prerana Deshpande is a well-known Kathak dancer worldwide.**
 
• Prerana Deshpande, **one of the top complete solo Kathak dancers **of her time, is regarded by aficionados as a solo dancer of acclaim and a creative choreographer of uncommon talent.
 
• Prerana is **regarded for her exquisite command over the fundamentals of Kathak - Rhythm, Grace, & Expression** - as well as for her creativity that is rooted in the tradition of this dance form.
 
• She is an **internationally acclaimed creative dancer **whose work reveals the perpetually expanding horizons of the traditional form.
 
• She is frequently **invited to perform as a solo artist at all important venues and festivals in India and abroad **because of how well-liked she is by audiences of all demographics for her proficiency in Kathak.
